_comment_auth_mode: Authentication policy mode: '2FA' (Identity Claim + Live Biometrics in ~2s) or '3FA' (Strict Exam Mode requiring RFC 6238 TOTP + Live Biometrics). Default: '2FA'.
_comment_grace_period: Number of consecutive missed checks before auto-locking (default: 2).
_comment_tolerance: Biometric Euclidean distance threshold. Lower = stricter (default: 0.60).
_comment_totp_valid_window: RFC 6238 TOTP time window tolerance in 30-second steps (default: 1 step / +-30s).
_comment_max_pause: Maximum seconds faculty can pause monitoring before fail-safe auto-resumes (default: 300).
_comment_jwt_expiry_hours: Lifetime of issued per-device OAuth2 JWT access tokens in hours (default: 24).
_comment_alerting: Optional webhook URL for Real-Time Incident Alerting (e.g., Discord/Slack). Leave empty to disable.
